findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_endpoints" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Searches for paid API endpoints (x402) by task in natural language. Returns a structured plan (plan[]) with candidates. IMPORTANT: each candidate contains a routeId. To execute a found endpoint, pass this routeId to the call_endpoint tool. Do not attempt to call the URL directly — use call_endpoint." → after: "FREE search for paid API endpoints (x402) by task. Pass either a natural-language query (the planner will split it) or pre-split queries[]. Returns a structured plan with up to `maxRoutesPerQuery` candidates per sub-query. No auth. Limits: burst 200/10s, total 1000/15min per IP; free probes 10/h per"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
